activity_summary: You tried the Capulet wedding morning with Tom, Kemp, and Nick. Tom read the father plain and flat, down to the spices, and the plainness was the danger. Kemp found a pause nobody had written, and Nick laughed without being asked. You wrote the pause in. Kemp said a pause lets a man put a whole life in it. You said you saw it, and you did not promise more. You kept the jaw tender, and you named no one for the afternoon king.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Defended the hurry of the kitchen, wrote the pause, and refused a second and a crust.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Read old Capulet flat, and kept him among small orders.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Waited where nothing was written, and named what a pause can hold.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Laughed unasked, and was told not to hunt the laugh.

entities.name: the Capulet wedding
entities.context: Mentioned in Three leaves, and a wait

entities.name: the pause
entities.context: Mentioned in Three leaves, and a wait

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: Give a man a pause and he'll fill it with a whole life.

quotes.speaker: thomas_pope
